gloss: to punctuate; to divide, to mark off

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {区切|くぎ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to divide, to mark off, to segment
definitions.explanation: To separate something into sections or segments by marking boundaries. Used for dividing text, time, space, or abstract concepts.

definitions.gloss: to bring to a close, to put a stop to
definitions.explanation: To mark a stopping point or conclusion in an activity or period.

examples.english: Read by dividing the sentence into segments.

examples.japanese: ⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{区切|くぎ}った。
examples.english: I divided the room with a curtain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧{区切|くぎ}る。
examples.english: Separate words by inserting spaces between them.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧{区切|くぎ}ろう。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{区切|くぎ}り→区切り：21082_kugiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'll finish up my work before heading home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{区切|くぎ}り→区切り：21082_kugiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めたい。
examples.english: I want to put the past behind me and start a new life.

notes:
The noun form ⟦{区切|くぎ}り→区切り：21082_kugiri⟧ is very common and often appears in the set phrase ⟦{区切|くぎ}り→区切り：21082_kugiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to bring something to a close, to draw a line).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{区切|くぎ}り→区切り：21082_kugiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ — to bring to a close, to draw a line
- ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧{区切|くぎ}る — to pause/stop at one point
- ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{区切|くぎ}る — to break a sentence into parts
- ⟦{段落|だんらく}→段落：14932_danraku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{区切|くぎ}る — to divide by paragraphs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧ — to divide, to separate (more general)
- ⟦{仕切|しき}る→仕切る：04666_shikiru⟧ — to partition, to manage
